The successful candidate will perform the full range of planning, coordinating and performing secure and nonsecure IT initiatives that support continuity of operations (COOP) and incident response (IR) facilities.

Work includes project management, process improvement, hands-on operational support, and contract oversight to ensure established cost, schedule, quality goals, and performance objectives are met; serving as an authoritative expert and consultant on IT business process improvements and information technologies, system implementation, and service delivery; and supporting the implementation and maintenance of IT service request processes that enable continuity and incident response programs.

Assignments involve the development and periodic review of IT and communications procedures and the resolution of related policy and technical issues relating to security requirements for the COOP program.

Additionally, the work involves regularly accessing and handling sensitive information, including Safeguards Information and classified/restricted data documents and/or materials.

Such duties include but are not limited to: The IT Project Manager (ITPM) oversees and maintains the agency's critical IT infrastructure, cloud environments, and software systems. This role troubleshoots complex technical issues, stays current on emerging technologies, and advises leadership on IT improvements and security needs.

The ITPM collaborates across the agency to apply consistent project management practices aligned with NRC's PMM. The role supports COOP and incident response operations, reviews agency policies for IT impact, and ensures reliable Digital Service Center (DSC) performance.

Key responsibilities include leading needs assessments, improving IT processes, coordinating efforts between Office of the Chief Information Officer and stakeholders, and conducting technical audits and feasibility studies.

The ITPM also develops business cases and cost estimates, ensures projects meet architectural and security standards, and supports key lifecycle activities such as Capital Planning and Investment Control (CPIC) and Office of Management and Budget (OMB) submissions, along with audits and risk assessments.

The role further contributes to strengthening business processes to enhance overall organizational efficiency. The ITPM represents the NRC in engagements with internal and external partners, sharing information on technologies, policies, and best practices.

They provide technical direction to contractors and oversee project scope, documentation, procurement materials, and project tracking.
Candidates may qualify for the 2210, Information Technology Management Series by meeting the Experience requirements specified in the Qualifications section of this announcement. Individuals must have IT-related experience demonstrating each of the four competencies listed below.

Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

In order to qualify for this position, you must have at least one year of specialized experience at the next lower grade level in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE is defined as: providing advanced IT project management and technical support for COOP and incident response operations, including maintaining secure and nonsecure infrastructure, resolving complex technical issues, and ensuring continuity readiness.

This experience includes leading IT projects using formal lifecycle methodologies; conducting analyses and developing business cases; applying cybersecurity, OPSEC, and regulatory requirements; properly handling sensitive, Safeguards, and classified information; coordinating with internal and external partners; and clearly communicating technical issues to senior leadership in support of mission-critical continuity and response programs.

The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate the following: 1. Demonstrated capability to plan, execute, control, and close medium- to large-scale IT projects using formal methodologies (e.g., PMM, CPIC), including scope, schedule, cost, project funding and budget activities, risk, reporting, and stakeholder engagement. 2.

Experience applying IT solutions to Continuity of Operations (COOP) and/or Incident Response (IR) programs, including facility support and alignment with security requirements; and coordination with agency and interagency stakeholders. 3.

Demonstrated ability to conduct audits, feasibility studies, tradeoffs, cost/benefit, and develop business cases; recommend IT solutions that enhance effectiveness, efficiency, and productivity. 4.

Experience evaluating knowledge and application of security requirements and controls, including the establishment and maintenance of IT systems which handle Safeguards Information and classified/restricted data in accordance with Federal and/or NRC policy. 5.

Demonstrated clarity, concision, and logic in oral and written communication; effectiveness in interagency coordination, preparation of technical documents, and stakeholder engagement (Interagency partners, HQ offices, OCIO, regions, contractors).

A description of how you possess the specialized experience as well as how you meet the qualifications desired in an ideal candidate must be addressed in your resume. Applicants may also use the supplemental vacancy question to provide additional information pertaining to the specialized experience and ideal candidate criteria.

PLEASE BE CLEAR AND CONCISE. WE WILL NOT MAKE ASSUMPTIONS REGARDING YOUR EXPERIENCE.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Peterson Space Force Base, Colorado is searching for a Program Manager for the MILSATCOM Product Support Delta (NH-1101-03, GS 12/13 equivalent).

Description: Leads a cross-functional team of Government and contractor personnel providing sustainment/product support for United States Space Force Military Satellite Communication programs. Manages daily program execution in an effort to ensure fielded systems meet Space Operator/user's mission requirements.

Serves as the primary interface between the Government Program Office and Prime MILSATCOM Contractors. Manages existing contracts and plans/develops requirements for future contracts. Evaluates proposals to ensure proposed level(s) of effort and costs are in-line with Government requirements.

Oversees programs' Weapons Systems Sustainment (WSS) requirements and advocates for current and future funding needs.

Ideal Candidate: Prrogram management experience, familiarity with the defense acquisition management framework, prior experience developing and managing program/system requirements, working knowledge of the various acquisition disciplines (e.g.

Financial Management, Contracting, Logistics), Bachelor's Degree (mandatory), APDP (or equivalent) Program Management certification (highly desired) Key Skills and Abilities: 1.

Knowledge of the applicable principles, concepts, policies, and laws; functions, programs, and systems applicable to the duties of logistics contracts and program management and material support; sources, responsibilities, and means for providing assistance and advice to resolve logistics contracts and program management problems; and all aspects of logistics contracts and program management support. 2.

Knowledge of government and private industry policies and practices related to business management, industrial management, financial systems, technical concepts, and production practices.

Ability to gather, analyze, and evaluate a variety of program information, such as commercial business practices, market conditions, offer acceptability, contractor acceptability, contractor responsibility and/or performance to determine acquisition strategy and sources. 3.

Knowledge of the missions, roles, functions, organizational structures, and operation of the Department of Defense and entities that govern, interface with, and/or influence management control of proposed and ongoing service contracts. 4.

Knowledge of methods of supervision to hold others accountable for measurable high-quality, timely, and cost-effective results. Ability to plan, organize, and direct the functions of a unit and mentor, motivate, and appraise subordinate staff.

Determine objectives, make sound, well-informed, and objective decisions, set priorities, cause change, and accomplish organizational goals. 5.

Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, clearly, concisely, with technical accuracy and to use computers and a variety of software programs and databases, gather and analyze a variety of program information, make sound judgments concerning program progress, and effectively communicate recommendations orally and in writing to higher organizational management and contractors. 6.

Ability to establish and maintain good relationships with individuals and groups within the office as well as outside the immediate work unit and to be persuasive in representing the best interests of the government when dealing with personnel with highly divergent points of view. 7.

Ability to plan, organize, analyze problems, translate complex information, make appropriate judgments, evaluate options, conduct research, summarize results, make appropriate recommendations, and manage critical aspects of service contract requirements as related to the assigned functional area and meet deadlines.

Ability to compose and edit contract required correspondence, review and analyze directives, develop and brief service contract program related presentations.

You will serve as a Technical Project Lead (TPL) for the Afloat Counter Unmanned Systems (ACUS) portfolio.
You will be responsible for the technical baseline and risk management, employing an agile, iterative approach to evaluate emerging technologies and ensure the continuous delivery of safe, authorized, and effective C-UxS solutions.
You will lead technical efforts by coordinating activities across Ship Integration and Certification, Launcher and Gun-Based Effectors, Fire Direction, and Systems Engineering.
You will provide hands-on guidance to a diverse engineering team, ensuring strict adherence to engineering best practices and driving the technical review of all deliverables.
You will lead a cross-functional team to ensure successful project execution and alignment with program and sponsor goals, while fostering collaboration across technical and programmatic disciplines to achieve project success.
You will evaluate emerging technologies and systems to accelerate delivery of rapid capabilities to the Fleet, employing a highly agile, iterative engineering approach focused on continuous/rapid deployment of effective ship self-defense solutions.
You will provide hands-on technical leadership to a diverse engineering team, resolving complex system issues, enforcing engineering best practices, and validating all technical deliverables prior to fleet release.
You will serve as the primary technical engineering authority, owning the engineering approach, driving key design decisions, and actively managing technical risks to ensure system viability.
You will formulate strategic technical guidance and roadmaps in collaboration with the ACUS leadership team to ensure project activities integrate seamlessly into the overall program strategy and support the long-term viability of C-UxS capabilities.
You will lead the technical execution and delivery of project products to the Fleet, interfacing directly with program offices, In­Service Engineering Agents (ISEA), and stakeholders to ensure seamless integration.
You will manage, execute, and report on project operations, serving as the first line of escalation for project-specific successes and challenges, and collaborating closely with program leadership to address and resolve issues.
You will execute rigorous administrative project management duties, including developing Statements of Work (SOW), spend plans, and ensuring compliance with NSWCDD, E Department, Division, and Afloat Counter Unmanned Systems (ACUS) policies.
You will serve as the primary project representative, communicating effectively with team members, sponsors, and external organizations (as delegated by the PM) to ensure complete transparency and alignment with overarching program goals.
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the ND-04 (GS-12/13 equivalent) pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector as a professional engineer or scientist leading the technical architecture, design, and systems engineering of Department of War weapon systems.

Examples of qualifying experience may include: (1) Serving as a technical authority or lead systems engineer, owning the technical approach and making key engineering design decisions for complex weapon systems, effectors, or fire direction systems; (2) Providing hands-on technical leadership to engineering teams, including the review and validation of technical deliverables, the execution of formal systems engineering processes, and the active management of technical risks; (3) Leading technical efforts in design, development and integration of emerging capabilities.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/#url=List-by-Occupational-Series AND https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/0800/files/all-professional-engineering-positions-0800.pdf General Physical Science Series, 1301 (opm.gov) Operations Research Series 1515 (opm.gov) Mathematics Series 1520 (opm.gov) Computer Science Series 1550 (opm.gov) Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

Why LeoLabs ? At LeoLabs , we're building the living map of activity in space. Through our proprietary global radar network and AI-enabled analytics platform, we collect millions of measurements daily on more than 25,000 objects in low Earth orbit (LEO).

Our radar-powered intelligence protects billions in assets, monitors adversarial behavior, and ensures safe operations for commercial and government missions. We're not just building technology, we are redefining global security, safety, and transparency in space.

As orbital activity accelerates and threats grow more complex, LeoLabs is a trusted partner for Space Domain Awareness, Space Traffic Management, and Satellite Operations for top-tier space operators and allied defense organizations.

If you're looking to work on mission-critical challenges at the forefront of aerospace, national security, and AI, your impact starts here.

LeoLabs is seeking a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead the technical execution, integration, and operational performance of advanced radar systems supporting space domain awareness and national security missions.

This role will oversee all contracts and awards, ensuring they are scoped into the work the radar systems team needs to work on, keeping track of conflicts and continuing work to ensure execution of all deliverables.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in project management, planning, contract navigation, and software development life cycles. **This is a remote position with occasional travel to Menlo Park and other client sites. Responsibilities Contracts and Engineering
Derive engineering requirements, milestones, and deliverables from contracts in collaboration with go-to-market and product teams.
Work alongside Radar Systems technical leaders to plan engineering solutions that satisfy contract requirements and deliverables.
Collaborate with radar product managers to ensure engineering priorities align with company strategy and incoming contract commitments.

Own requirements management, working with product management to develop, decompose, and record requirements in Altium Requirements and Systems Portal.
Maintain traceability from contract language through engineering implementation and verification.
Own tracking and on-time delivery of contract deliverables, leading or coordinating with technical writers as needed.
Maintain deliverable status and milestone progress summaries for internal stakeholders.
Project Execution, Scheduling, and Prioritization
Lead project planning and execution for radar system development, integration, testing, and operational support, ensuring milestones and deliverables are met on time and within scope.
Work with technical leaders to assess level of effort and balance workload across the team.
Develop and maintain project schedules that reflect realistic effort estimates, track contract milestones, and surface schedule risks early.
Manage project tracking workflows in Jira, ensuring work items are current, well-structured, and linked to contract milestones.
Drive engineering prioritization decisions in consultation with go-to-market and technical leaders, ensuring decisions are communicated clearly and reflected in team work plans.
Own person-hour budgeting across active and incoming contracts; provide data-driven input to hiring and staffing decisions by maintaining visibility into current and projected engineering demand.
Communication and Coordination
Serve as the primary liaison between the Radar Systems engineering team and internal stakeholders (contracts, product, go-to-market, and government compliance teams).
Provide status reporting to engineering leadership on project health, schedule adherence, resource utilization, and risks.

As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the LATAM region.
This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement.

As a Program Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make smart trade-offs between competing priorities.

* Ausbildung: Hochschulabschluss (Master), vorzugsweise mit rechts- oder politikwissenschaftlicher Ausrichtung

* Kompetenzen: Sie sind sich gewohnt, vernetzt zu denken und besitzen eine strukturierte und präzise Arbeitsweise. Zudem zeigen Sie sich umgänglich in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Anspruchsgruppen
## Wir bieten ##
Sie erhalten die Chance, Ihren Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitzugestalten und eigene Impulse einzubringen. Es erwartet Sie eine abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld, eingebettet in ein kollegiales und engagiertes Team, das sich auf Ihre Tatkraft freut.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten sowie vielfältige interne Weiterbildungsangebote schaffen die nötige Flexibilität für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is availablehere .

Du hast bereits in einer Agentur gearbeitet , behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick und fühlst dich zwischen Kundenmeeting, Contentproduktion und Projektplanung wohl?
Dann suchen wir dich als Projektmanager (m/w/d) für unser Team bei wirdenkenlokal .
Wir sind Medienhaus und Agentur mit Sitz in Nürnberg und unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbar zu werden , neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen . Dafür entwickeln und realisieren wir Projekte rund um Social Media, Video- und Fotoproduktion, Onlinekampagnen, PR und Events .
Für die Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt , strukturiert arbeitet und gleichzeitig versteht, dass Agenturalltag nicht immer nach Lehrbuch läuft.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Steuerung unserer Agenturprojekte – von der Planung über die Koordination der Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei betreust du Social-Media-Projekte, Videoproduktionen, Fotoshootings und weitere Online-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, führst regelmäßige Kundentermine und berätst sie entlang unseres Leistungsportfolios. Du verstehst, was der Kunde erreichen möchte, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende Lösungen.
Koordination & Überblick: Mehrere Kunden, unterschiedliche Deadlines und verschiedene interne Ansprechpartner gleichzeitig? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du priorisierst Aufgaben, koordinierst Timings und Ressourcen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was wann zu tun ist.
Contentproduktionen: Du bist nicht nur am Schreibtisch: Bei ausgewählten Video- und Fotoproduktionen unterstützt du unser Team vor Ort, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Kreativen sicher, dass die Anforderungen des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Social-Media-Managern, Videografen, Fotografen und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Informationen, Feedback und Freigaben laufen bei dir zusammen und werden von dir strukturiert weitergegeben.
Projektmanagement mit Awork: Wir organisieren unsere Projekte mit Awork. Du musst das Tool noch nicht kennen – Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Awork, Asana, Monday, Trello oder vergleichbaren Lösungen setzen wir allerdings voraus.
KI & Prozessoptimierung: Wir nutzen KI bereits intensiv in unserem Arbeitsalltag und wollen das weiter ausbauen. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sowohl innerhalb von Kundenprojekten als auch zur Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse einzusetzen, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Qualifikation
Agenturerfahrung: Du hast bereits in einer Marketing-, Social-Media-, Digital-, Content- oder vergleichbaren Agentur gearbeitet und kennst die Dynamik des Agenturalltags.
Erfahrung im Online-Marketing: Du bringst praktische Vorerfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für Social Media, Contentproduktion und Onlinekampagnen mit. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können – aber du solltest verstehen, wie gute Projekte in diesen Bereichen geplant und realisiert werden.
Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig steuern, Prioritäten setzen und verlierst auch dann nicht den Überblick, wenn an einem Tag fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.
Stressresistenz: Wenn es turbulent wird, wirst du nicht hektisch, sondern fokussiert. Du kannst mit Zeitdruck, kurzfristigen Änderungen und intensiveren Projektphasen umgehen und läufst dann eher zur Höchstform auf, als den Überblick zu verlieren.
Kommunikationsstärke: Eine klare, professionelle und zielführende Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – setzen wir voraus. Du kannst sowohl souverän mit Kunden kommunizieren als auch intern klare Briefings und Aufgaben formulieren.
Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, sprichst Probleme frühzeitig an und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Interesse an Marketing & Medien: Social Media, Marketing, Medien und digitale Kommunikation interessieren dich auch über deine unmittelbaren Aufgaben hinaus. Du willst verstehen, welche Plattformen, Formate und Entwicklungen gerade relevant sind.
Offenheit für KI: ChatGPT, Claude und andere KI-Tools sind für dich keine Bedrohung, sondern Werkzeuge. Du hast Lust darauf, herauszufinden, wie wir damit bessere Ergebnisse erzielen und effizienter arbeiten können.

Abwechslung statt immer gleicher Projekte: Vom regionalen Mittelständler bis zum Konzern, von Social-Media-Betreuung über Recruitingkampagnen bis zur Videoproduktion: Du arbeitest mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und an sehr unterschiedlichen Projekten.
Du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: Unsere Projekte sollen nicht einfach nur gut aussehen. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbarer zu werden, neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen – insbesondere Unternehmen aus unserer Region.
Ein Arbeitsplatz mit Aussicht: Unser Büro befindet sich im Business Tower Nürnberg – in einem der höchsten Büros der Region.
Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Du arbeitest in einem Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem nahbaren Führungsteam. Gute Ideen müssen bei uns nicht erst durch fünf Hierarchieebenen.
Moderne Arbeitsweise: Wir arbeiten digital, nutzen moderne Projektmanagement- und KI-Tools und entwickeln unsere internen Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns genauso dazu wie die notwendige Flexibilität, die ein abwechslungsreicher Agenturalltag manchmal mit sich bringt.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir wachsen als Unternehmen weiter – und damit entstehen auch für dich Möglichkeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

## Was du bewirkst ##
* Du leitest das Projekt als Co-Lead zur Einführung von Agentic AI in der Schadenbearbeitung - Umsetzung in iterativen Ausbauschritten.
* Du verantwortest die Automatisierungs-Roadmap im Schadenumfeld und treibst den Ausbau der Ende-zu-Ende-Dunkelverarbeitung in den Massenschäden massgeblich voran
* Du arbeitest eng mit Schadenspezialisten, IT-Architektur und Technologiepartnern zusammen, um KI-Agenten mit klaren Entscheidungsgrenzen in neugestaltete Prozessen zu integrieren

* Du bereitest Entscheidungsvorlagen auf und vertrittst das Projekt im Steuerungsausschuss Schaden-Transformation sowie gegenüber der Geschäftsleitung
* Du begleitest den Kulturwandel im Schadenteam - von der klassischen Fallbearbeitung hin zu einer modernen Schadenerledigung in Zusammenarbeit mit KI-Agenten
## Was du mitbringst ##
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Digitalisierungs- und/ oder IT-Projekte mit Transformationscharakter, idealerweise im Schaden- oder Versicherungsumfeld
* Sehr gute Kenntnis von klassischen und agilen Vorgehensmodellen
* Täglicher Einsatz von KI und grundlegende Arbeitsweise mit KI Unterstützung

* Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Governance, Risiko und Compliance beim Einsatz von KI in einem regulierten Umfeld sowie ein klares Verständnis von Responsible-AI-Prinzipien (Transparenz, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Fairness)
